about_contact_body: Write to us and the ConferenceHub team will reply as soon as possible.
about_creator_body: Induwara designed and built ConferenceHub from the ground up: the FastAPI backend, the React app, the QR check-in desk and the Sinhala and Tamil translations, so organizers across Sri Lanka can run their events in their own language.
about_lead: ConferenceHub is a platform for publishing conferences in Sri Lanka, filling seats and welcoming attendees at the door. It is designed for universities, companies, associations and community groups.
about_mission_body: Good events often struggle with scattered sign-up forms, unclear venues and long queues at the entrance. ConferenceHub brings registration, waitlists, reminders, maps and QR check-in together in one place, in the language each person prefers.
about_mission_title: Make every event easy to find and easy to run

faq_1_a: Open My Conferences and choose "New conference". Fill in the details, save, then add a cover image, agenda and speakers.
faq_1_q: How do I create a conference?
faq_2_a: Set a seat limit. When it is reached, new people join the waitlist. If someone cancels, or you raise the limit, the first person in line gets the seat and an email.
faq_3_a: Open Check-in, choose the conference and start the camera. Point it at the QR code on each ticket, or type the ticket code by hand.
faq_3_q: How do I check people in?
faq_4_a: Yes. Their ticket link has a "Cancel registration" button. The seat then goes to the waitlist.
faq_5_a: Automatically the day before the conference. You can also send one right away from the Attendees page.

privacy_lead: ConferenceHub collects only what it needs to run conferences, and never sells or shares your details for advertising.
privacy_s1_body:
When you register for a conference: your name, email address, preferred language, your ticket and the time you were checked in.
Organizers: name, email address, organization, profile photo and a password that is stored only as a one-way hash.
The contact form: your name, email address and message.
privacy_s2_body: To hold your seat, send your confirmation code and ticket, remind you the day before, and tell you if the conference changes or is cancelled. We do not send newsletters or advertising.
privacy_s3_body: Your registration is shown only to the organizer of that conference. The platform administrator can see accounts and messages to keep the service safe. Public conference pages never show attendee names.
privacy_s4_body: We use only the cookies the site needs to work: two that keep an organizer signed in and one security token that protects forms. Your light or dark theme choice is kept in your browser. There are no tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy_s5_body: The site is served only over HTTPS. Passwords are hashed with Argon2, sign-in and code entry are rate-limited, and each ticket is protected by an email confirmation code.
privacy_s6_body: You can cancel a registration at any time from your ticket link. To see, correct or delete what we hold about you, email us and we will reply within a few working days.

terms_lead: These terms explain how ConferenceHub may be used by organizers and attendees. By using the site you agree to them.
terms_s1_body: ConferenceHub is a free platform for publishing conferences in Sri Lanka and registering for them, in English, Sinhala and Tamil.
terms_s2_body: Give accurate details and keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for the conferences you publish and for how you use attendee details, which may be used only to run that conference. The administrator may suspend accounts that break these terms.
terms_s3_body: Each email address can register once per conference. Confirm your email with the code we send, or the held seat is released. When a conference is full you may join its waitlist and get a seat if one frees up. You can cancel from your ticket link until the conference ends.
terms_s4_body: Do not publish anything unlawful, misleading, hateful or that you have no right to use. You keep ownership of what you post and allow ConferenceHub to show it on the site and in emails. Content that breaks these rules may be removed.
terms_s5_body: Each conference is run by its organizer, who is responsible for the event itself, its venue and any changes or cancellation. ConferenceHub provides the tools and is not a party to the event.
terms_s6_body: We work to keep the site running but provide it as is, without a guarantee that it is always available. These terms may change; the date at the top shows the latest version.
